domain: GPS envelope in mean-wind axes; source 10..400 m upwind of minimum observation x; y within observed envelope
spatial_thinning: CP every 2 rows (2 Hz); OP means by published integer TimeStamp; not cross-platform synchronization
objective: Gaussian concentration least squares; nonnegative Q profiled; same Q and dispersion for paired curtains
uncertainty: profile RSS <= 1.05 * minimum RSS support extent; diagnostic, NOT posterior credible interval
sensitivity: broader dispersion support; primary outputs preserved; no result used to choose best wind arm
